The second reading is taken in a child process (loop_not_stale.fresh_import_reading), seeded from this process's sys.path so the only difference between the two readings is what is already held in memory — taking it in-process was measured 2026-08-18 to reproduce a stale loop's own failure and so to read the misattribution as a real defect. The carry also names the pair `reproduces_here_but_not_fresh`, which is the loop-is-the-culprit signature, and the coverage tally from staleness.diagnostics(). The quiet face (a held module whose disk source would compile a different object) is DETECTED by that tally and reported, not triggered on: watching it per beat was priced at ~200 ms over 77 held modules against a 2531 ms beat and declined, with a ticket owed for a cheap freshness witness.
watchme.enough: unchanged in substance and now spelled by code: PROBE.enough clears only when nothing is wrongly benched AND the store's record of this condition last occurred BEFORE this process started — a restart survived, not a quiet period. 30 days with zero misattributed benches and no true bench at all leaves the watch OPEN and saying so, because a run of zeros over a corpus where nothing ever broke measures nothing.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier, carrying the standing-trouble sweep's per-device readings (reproduced / not-reproduced) as evidence, not a count alone — the sibling voyage measured tonight that over a clean corpus a live fix and a reverted one print the same zeros.
